context: Replaces the explicit null check with null-conditional access for cleaner code. `_userRepo.GetById` returns null when no user matches.
explanation: Removing the null guard and using ?. on Profile does not protect the next line — user.Email still dereferences user directly and throws NullReferenceException when user is null. Fix: keep the early-return null check, or apply ?. consistently and handle the null case before accessing user.Email.
